summary: Frontend retest of two micro-fixes: (1) Admin athletes list rendering all items on first mount (no reload needed), (2) AthleteTabBar exposing testID attributes in DOM. Both fixes verified working.

test_results.admin_athletes_list: PASS - Header shows 'Atleti (3)' and all 3 athletes (NOFC Test, REACT Test, MAURI LENA) rendered at first mount without reload or scroll. Section 'Da controllare (2)' and section 'M' both fully rendered. Virtualization fix effective.
test_results.athlete_tab_bar_testids: PASS - All 5 data-testid attributes found in DOM: athlete-tab-bar, athlete-tab-dafare, athlete-tab-anagrafica, athlete-tab-compensi, athlete-tab-presenze. Clicking athlete-tab-anagrafica (after dismissing 'Dati Personali' onboarding modal via 'Salta') successfully navigates to /athlete/profile.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Layout children warnings for non-existent routes 'preseason', 'admin/whatsapp-reminders', 'admin/whatsapp-settings' in app/_layout — cosmetic console noise, low priority.
Note: The athlete onboarding modal 'Dati Personali' intercepts tab clicks — testers/users must dismiss it first. Not a bug, but worth noting for future test flows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both micro-fixes confirmed. Admin account had only 3 athletes so full-list rendering was verified against small dataset — if a larger dataset becomes available, re-verify with e.g. 50+ athletes to stress-test virtualization params (initialNumToRender=1000). AthleteTabBar testIDs confirmed via data-testid attribute in web DOM.
